question: Who among the following was appointed as the new Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Chairman in February 2025, becoming the first serving Finance Secretary to assume the role?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuhin Kanta Pandey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tuhin Kanta Pandey**, a **1987-batch IAS officer** of the **Odisha cadre**, was appointed as the new **Chairman** of the **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)** in **February 2025**.
 
• He made history by becoming the **first serving Finance Secretary** to be appointed as the chief of the capital markets regulator.
 
• Before this prestigious appointment, he served as the **Finance Secretary** and **Secretary** of the **Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM)** under the **Ministry of Finance**.
